webApps.description: A simple kanban board that is persistant across sessions. It features: adding and editing cards, editing columns, undo/redo actions, import/export features, themes.
A simple calculator that binds the physical keyboard with the GUI, allowing type/click/push input. It's made with ReactJS and it also features key sounds.
Simple app made with ReactJS that automatically identifies the units of temperature the user types in, and converts the amount to other units.
This was my first big project. It's an app that allows to draw weird shapes everytime the user clicks over the white canvas. It allows shapes customization and language selection.
I improved the bouncing balls game that was developed at MDN course site, allowing multiplayer and diagonal moves. Use arrow and A/W/S/D keys to play the game. Only for Desktop.
App that fetches random quotes and display it to the user, made with ReactJS and react-transition-group for the main transition.
A simple app made with ReactJS that previews markdown input.

Web app library that displays information about meteorite landings on earth, using NASA API. It features Filter Controls, Infinite Scroll, Responsive Design, Personalized Color (based on meteorite structure).

Responsive SPA that fetches data from an API, lists it in a pleasant, paginated approach. Supports multiple language, currency conversion, personalized filter/search, and upload comments/receipts to each expense independently.

extensions.description: Contributed for 6 years in the development of Adblock Plus. Mostly in the extensions API integration, UI components and their Marketing API.
Contributed for 5 years in the development of AdBlock. Mostly in the extensions API integration, UI components and their Marketing API.
Born from a forum user request. I designed, developed and maintained my first browser extension, that allows the user to filter and manage tabs either manually or automatically.
